relationship.R7: product fast-closure execution layer; it replaces neither and adds no third route

forbidden_inferences: a plugin manifest = a finished plugin system

gates.name: RECONCILE
gates.objective: History + Library + main + PR156/157/158 + Local fully reconciled; no asset lost.

measured.merge_order: #156 (to main) -> #157 -> #158, with a conflict re-check before #158

gates.exit_criteria: Every cloud and local asset has a SHA, an authority, an implementation status and a disposition; the history archive verifies against its own manifest.

gates.name: TRUSTED CORE
gates.objective: Freeze Source, Knowledge, Evidence, Version, Review, learning state, AI candidate state and the plugin contract; add the plugin registry, capability resolver, enable/disable, health, default/fallback and provider replacement.
existing: crates/archeaxis-api + application + domain already own Source, Knowledge, Evidence, Version, Review and learning state, with a single-writer boundary
capability routes already resolve a declared capability to a worker script (launch-declared routes, Executor::open_routes, KNOWN_WORKER_IDENTITIES)
a readiness checker reports per-route capability by launching the Core
missing: a capability resolver exposed over HTTP
gates.exit_criteria: A capability can be registered, resolved, disabled and health-checked without editing the Core, and no plugin writes the canonical database.

gates.name: UNIVERSAL KNOWLEDGE
gates.objective: First batch TXT, MD, PDF, HTML, Image/OCR, DOCX; second batch PPTX, XLSX, Audio/ASR, Video; the chain Import -> Raw Asset -> Source -> Transform -> Anchor -> Knowledge -> Evidence -> Search -> Ask/Read.
missing: software compatibility: Markdown Folder, Obsidian Vault, Git, Notion Export
ask/read with citations over the knowledge store
video decode as a knowledge route
gates.exit_criteria: Each first-batch format reaches an Evidence anchor and a Knowledge object from a real file, and one external knowledge-software source imports.

gates.name: HUMAN LEARNING LITE
gates.objective: Knowledge -> Learning Objective -> Assessment -> User Answer -> Feedback -> FSRS -> Review -> Restart Readback, operable from the real UI, while keeping the full heavy Learning schema.

measured.fsrs: real scheduling when the launch interpreter can schedule; unavailable otherwise

missing: a real human operating the loop from the UI rather than from a probe
gates.exit_criteria: A person answers a generated question in the product UI, the schedule is recorded, and after a restart the same state reads back.

gates.name: MACHINE / CO-LEARNING LITE
gates.objective: Accepted Knowledge -> Real Task -> AI Output -> Human identifies a real error -> Correction Candidate -> Human Review -> Retest -> Result, then candidate generation for Knowledge/Memory/Rule/Skill with no automatic promotion.

measured.local_model_runtime: LM Studio on 127.0.0.1:1234 serving six models; a real caption and a real completion were produced
measured.comfyui: 0.33.1 with the H3 video stack resolvable through its API
measured.machine_routes: POST /machine/tasks records a receipt; it does not execute a model

missing: a capability route that runs a real model task and stores its output as a candidate
an error-identification surface bound to a human correction
gates.exit_criteria: One real model runs on accepted knowledge, a human marks a real error, the correction is reviewed, a retest runs, and the result is recorded - with nothing auto-promoted.

gates.name: DAILY PRODUCT / LOCAL GREEN
gates.objective: One golden journey end to end, then backup, restore, migration, candidate, Green and rollback, with replacement only after the Owner Gate.
gates.exit_criteria: The journey completes on a real file by a real person, and a restart reads everything back.

conclusion: Four gates are measurable now: G0 is done, G1 and G2 are largely present with named gaps, and G3 needs a human at the UI rather than more code. G4 is the first gate that is blocked by wiring rather than by a decision, and G5 depends on G4 plus the Owner Gate. There is one route, G0 -> G5, and nothing here creates a second.
